anonymity_scan.scope: Every supplied file, readable text, checkpoint pickle string metadata, NPZ numeric-array headers, PNG metadata, PDF text/metadata and decoded object streams. No unpickling performed in this independent scan.

checkpoint_scope: Recursive comparisons preserve every tensor, optimizer scalar, config number and available RNG state. A null equality field means the corresponding state category was absent from that source checkpoint.

independent_rms_preservation_audit.comparison: Canonical completed RMS study versus staged anonymous RMS study; read-only check. Text values may be anonymized; every checkpoint tensor, optimizer/RNG numeric field and NPZ array is exact.
independent_rms_preservation_audit.source_execution_scope: Completed read-only audit in the original dual-tree layout; supplied as provenance. Relative ORIGINAL and SUPPLIED locations need adaptation for another layout.
